title: S2-SW-06C SPACE WEATHER CAPABILITY DEVELOPMENT FOR IONOSPHERIC AND GEOMAGNETIC CONDITIONS
description: This activity will include two high priority capability developments with the aim to both provide new and improved products for endusers in Southern Europe and to investigate the potential future advances in related SWE Service Provision expected to be enabled through utilisation of the data from the planned Aurora mission. Both Southern Europe and Arctic region are targeted by this combinedactivity with the aim to explore potential synergies in terms of long-term development planning in both the ionospheric and geomagnetic conditions domains- Space Weather Product Developments for Southern Europe Part 2This activity will focus on further developingthe SWE Service Network capabilities targeting end users in Southern Europe. The activity will build on the work that has been carried out by two parallel SSA studies "P3-SWE-XXIII User requirements for Mediterranean region", followed by "P3-SWE-XXXVIII: SWE Products for Southern Europe Phase 1" which have both characterised regional user requirements, and further developed regional space weather capabilities tailored towards user needs in this region.This activity will particularly focus on expanding the SWE Services through development and incorporation of improved and/or additional products into the SWE Service Network in both geomagnetic conditions and ionospheric domains, with a regional focus.- Aurora Mission Data Utilisation StudyThis study will focus on the utilisation of measurement data foreseen to be provided by the Aurora mission, currently being developed within the ESA Space Safety Programme. The main aim of Aurora is to monitor the interaction of the solar wind and CMEs with the Earth environment along with the identification and nowcasting of geomagnetic disturbances. These capabilities are expected to underpin substantially improved service capabilities, particularly for users operating at high latitudes.The analysis will primarily focus on utilisation of the data to support advanced modelling and shall highlight the expected benefits in terms of improved service provision in particular for end users operating at high latitudes.The expected benefits shall be demonstrated by means of existing models and real/simulated data and may utilise the modelling framework currently under development within the P3-SWEXLV activity focussed on 3D magnetospheric modelling. Requirements for model and tool development in order to optimally utilise data from both Aurora-D (single satellite) and Aurora-C (4 satellites) for the purpose of space weather modelling, nowcast and forecasting shall be produced.

description: Dalkia est attributaire de la création de la chaufferie et du réseau de chaleur urbain sur les communes de Bayonne et Saint Pierre d'Irube. description: Die Einrichtung Flugexperimente des Deutschen Zentrums für Luft- und Raumfahrt (DLR) ist Europas größter Betreiber von Forschungsflugzeugen für Atmosphärenforschung und Erdbeobachtung.
